i.norm:
Verifies Soundex encoding for a representative batch of names taken from http://www.myatt.demon.co.uk/sxalg.htm.

A Soundex code is always four characters: the initial letter of the name followed by three digits that represent phonetically similar consonant groups. Shorter names are padded with zeros (e.g. "BALL" → "B400").

@param name the input name to encode @param expectedCode the expected four-character Soundex code
